title: 1:1 square ultra-realistic smartphone be
prompt:
1:1 square ultra-realistic smartphone beach snapshot.

An adult Japanese woman sitting on a crowded sandy beach during bright midsummer midday sunlight. The camera is extremely close to her, positioned slightly below waist level and angled subtly upward, creating mild wide-angle perspective where the lower torso and thighs appear slightly closer and larger than the head.

She is leaning backward with both straight arms placed behind her on the sand to support her upper body, naturally lifting her shoulders and slightly arching her torso. Her legs extend outward toward both lower corners and are strongly cropped by the frame.

Her head is turned toward the viewer's right, chin slightly lowered, eyes looking off-camera to the right rather than at the lens. Calm neutral expression.

Adult Japanese facial features, natural minimal makeup, realistic skin texture.

Dark brown to black medium-long hair loosely tied up behind the head, completely wet from seawater, messy damp strands falling naturally across the forehead, cheeks, neck and shoulders.

She wears a white-based floral triangle halter bikini with small colorful flowers in coral pink, red, orange, yellow and green. Gathered triangle bikini cups connected by thin strings. Matching low-rise floral bikini bottoms with thin side ties.

Her skin is slightly sun-kissed and covered with hundreds of very small realistic seawater droplets, especially on the shoulders, upper chest, abdomen and waist, producing subtle specular highlights rather than oily glossy skin.

Strong direct midday summer sunlight from above and slightly left. Warm skin highlights, realistic shadows under the chin, neck, bikini fabric and torso. Bright natural HDR smartphone exposure.

Background is a real, slightly crowded Japanese public beach, not a luxury resort. Blue ocean on the right, shallow-water swimmers, several beachgoers, a seated man facing away in dark navy swim trunks behind the subject, children and adults farther away, beach towels and turquoise-blue leisure mats on the left, scattered beach belongings, coastal buildings and a green hillside in the far background.

Bright blue summer sky with thin wispy white clouds crossing diagonally.

Smartphone wide-angle photography, approximately 24–28mm equivalent lens, close shooting distance, deep natural depth of field, background slightly softer but still recognizable.

Natural proportions, candid beach snapshot, realistic pores, realistic wet hair, realistic seawater droplets, highly detailed but not overprocessed, no cinematic lighting, no luxury resort aesthetic.

No text, no logos, no watermark, no icons, no app interface, no borders.
